adversaries.name: Adult Flickerfly
adversaries.description: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Never Misses
features.description: When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target's Evasion is halved against the attack.

features.name: Deadly Flight
features.description: While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.description: Spend a Fear to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take 3d8 direct physical damage.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.description: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.description: When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take 3d8+3 direct magic damage.

features.name: Uncanny Reflexes
features.description: When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to take half damage.

adversaries.name: Archmage
adversaries.description: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Orbiting Aegis
features.description: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

features.name: Force Salvo
features.description: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

features.name: Fireball
features.description: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

features.name: Counterspell
features.description: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

adversaries.name: Catrin
adversaries.description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

features.name: Attracted to Wealth
features.description: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

features.name: The Weight of Opulence
features.description: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

features.name: Expensive Failure
features.description: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

adversaries.name: Chimera
adversaries.description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.

features.name: Rending Jaws
features.description: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to

features.name: Double Claw
features.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target,

features.name: Breath of Fire
features.description: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an

features.name: Serpent Strike
features.description: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Crimson Lepus
adversaries.description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: "Awww..."
features.description: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Evasive
features.description: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

features.name: "Run Away!"
features.description: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

adversaries.name: Cryptimoth
adversaries.description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Psychic Screech
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Shadow Swarm
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

features.name: Paranoia Glare
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

adversaries.name: Cursed Merfolk
adversaries.description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

features.name: Fish-Tailed
features.description: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

features.name: Gang Up
features.description: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

features.name: "Get Over Here!"
features.description: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

adversaries.name: Deep Dweller
adversaries.description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Brain Drain
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Call of the Deep
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Mucosal Contamination
features.description: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrined in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

adversaries.name: Demon of Avarice
adversaries.description: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.

features.name: Money Talks
features.description: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon's standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.

features.name: Numbers Must Go Up
features.description: Add a bonus to the Demon's attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.

features.name: Money Is Time
features.description: Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear) to spotlight 1d4+1 allies.

adversaries.name: Demon of Despair
adversaries.description: A cloaked demon-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.

features.name: Depths of Despair
features.description: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

features.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
features.description: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

features.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
features.description: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Demon of Hubris
adversaries.description: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.description: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

features.name: Unparalleled Skill
features.description: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon's standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

features.name: The Root of Villainy
features.description: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

features.name: You Pale in Comparison
features.description: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Demon of Jealousy
adversaries.description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.

features.name: Unprotected Mind
features.description: The Demon's standard attack deals direct damage.

features.name: My Turn
features.description: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Rivalry
features.description: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

features.name: What's Yours Is Mine
features.description: When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or consumable of their choice from the target's inventory.

adversaries.name: Demon of Wrath
adversaries.description: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.

features.name: Anger Unrelenting
features.description: The Demon's attacks deal direct damage.

features.name: Battle Lust
features.description: Spend a Fear to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

features.name: Blood and Souls
features.description: Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon 1d4 Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

adversaries.name: Dire Bat
adversaries.description: A wide-winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

features.name: Flying
features.description: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Screech
features.description: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Guardian
features.description: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Drake
adversaries.description: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Guard Dog
features.description: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

adversaries.name: Dryad
adversaries.description: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.

features.name: Bramble Patch
features.description: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

features.name: Grow Saplings
features.description: Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: We Are All One
features.description: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally's life force is returned to the forest.

adversaries.name: Dullahan
adversaries.description: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.

features.name: Specter
features.description: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Spectral Mount
features.description: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

features.name: Bone Whip Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they

features.name: Death Glare
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

adversaries.name: Elemental Spark
adversaries.description: A blazing mote of elemental fire.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Fellmounted Shadow King
adversaries.description: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

features.name: Fellmount
features.description: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he's knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Light and Shadow
features.description: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

features.name: Relic Hunter
features.description: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

features.name: Hellsong
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King's mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can't lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

features.name: Air Support
features.description: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with

adversaries.name: Fire Titan
adversaries.description: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Msterwork Armor
features.description: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack

features.name: Hurl Rock
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

features.name: Skull Splitter
features.description: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress

features.name: Blazing Heart
features.description: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

adversaries.name: Frost Titan
adversaries.description: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: War Horn
features.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.description: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

features.name: Cleaving Strike
features.description: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Trophy Hunter
features.description: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

adversaries.name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle
adversaries.description: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Piercing Bite
features.description: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

features.name: Tail Bash
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

features.name: Gigaton Splash
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Steam Breath
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

adversaries.name: Greater Earth Elemental
adversaries.description: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.

features.name: Slow
features.description: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Crushing Blows
features.description: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.description: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

features.name: Rockslide
features.description: Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 2d12+5 physical damage and become Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Greater Water Elemental
adversaries.description: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.

features.name: Water Jet
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+7 physical damage and the target's next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Drowning Embrace
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

features.name: High Tide
features.description: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to knock the target back to Close range.

adversaries.name: Head Vampire
adversaries.description: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Look into My Eyes
features.description: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

features.name: Feed on Followers
features.description: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: The Hunt Is On
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Lifesuck
features.description: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

adversaries.name: Huge Green Ooze
adversaries.description: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.

features.name: Slow
features.description: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.description: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Split
features.description: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

adversaries.name: Hydra
adversaries.description: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.

features.name: Many-Headed Menace
features.description: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Terrifying Chorus
features.description: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Magical Weakness
features.description: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

adversaries.name: Lamia
adversaries.description: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.

features.name: Constriction
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.description: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4-1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.description: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

adversaries.name: Lamplight Beguiler
adversaries.description: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
motives_tactics: speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

features.name: Doppel-Dangler
features.description: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

features.name: Entice
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

features.name: Gulp
features.description: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swllowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

adversaries.name: Manticore
adversaries.description: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.description: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.description: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.description: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

adversaries.name: Monarch
adversaries.description: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.

features.name: Execute Them!
features.description: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Crownsguard
features.description: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

features.name: Casus Belli
features.description: Long-Term Countdown. Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

adversaries.name: Night Children
adversaries.description: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swell Ranks
features.description: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

adversaries.name: Oak Treant
adversaries.description: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.

features.name: Just a Tree
features.description: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Seed Barrage
features.description: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

features.name: Take Root
features.description: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

adversaries.name: Pain Priest
adversaries.description: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.
motives_tactics: tempt them with their deepest desires

features.name: Walk Between Worlds
features.description: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Pleasure and Pain
features.description: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

adversaries.name: Phoenix
adversaries.description: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.

features.name: Purifying Aura
features.description: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Fireseed
features.description: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within

features.name: Resurrection
features.description: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared,

adversaries.name: Plesiosaurus
adversaries.description: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.description: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can t be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

adversaries.name: Roc
adversaries.description: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.description: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.description: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

features.name: Nest Warden
features.description: When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features: Wrothful - Passive: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked Electrifying Aura - Passive: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

adversaries.name: Sandwyrm
adversaries.description: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.description: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

adversaries.name: Shapeshifting Fiend
adversaries.description: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.description: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonte
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.description: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.description: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Exposed! (Phose Change)
features.description: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed
adversaries.description: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Fiendish Resistance
features.description: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Demonic Rage
features.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Hall of Mirrors
features.description: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Flosh Claw
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20

features.name: Mind Games
features.description: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

adversaries.name: Stag Knight
adversaries.description: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.

features.name: From Above
features.description: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Blade of the Forest
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target's Major threshold.

features.name: Thorny Armor
features.description: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

adversaries.name: Storm Titan
adversaries.description: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.description: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

adversaries.name: Treant Sapling
adversaries.description: A small, sentient tree sapling.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Unicorn
adversaries.description: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.

features.name: Celestial Lance
features.description: The Unicorn's standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.description: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally's HP.

features.name: Protective Aura
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

adversaries.name: Vampire
adversaries.description: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.

features.name: Draining Bite
features.description: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: Mistform
features.description: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

adversaries.name: Vampire Bat Swarm
adversaries.description: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.description: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsuckers
features.description: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

adversaries.name: Vampire Lord
adversaries.description: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Midnight Heart
features.description: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it's destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Unleash Hellfire
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Resurgence
features.description: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Melt into Shadow
features.description: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

features.name: Hellwing
features.description: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the "On Crimson Wings" and "Bloodbath" features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack: Claws: Close | 3d12+6 phy On Crimson Wings - Passive: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Bloodbath - Reaction: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

adversaries.name: Vault Guardian Gaoler
adversaries.description: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.

features.name: Blocking Shield
features.description: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

features.name: Lock Up
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

adversaries.name: Vault Guardian Sentinel
adversaries.description: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.

features.name: Kinetic Slam
features.description: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Box In
features.description: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.description: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Vault Guardian Turret
adversaries.description: A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston-driven mechanical legs.

features.name: Slow Firing
features.description: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.description: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.description: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.description: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

adversaries.name: Viscera Sucker
adversaries.description: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.

features.name: Join or Die
features.description: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

adversaries.name: Whisper Wraith
adversaries.description: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.

features.name: Greater Specter
features.description: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Spooky
features.description: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Nightmare Shroud
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

adversaries.name: Wyvern
adversaries.description: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.

features.name: Double Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.description: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

adversaries.name: Young Fire Dragon
adversaries.description: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.description: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a

features.name: Flame Breath
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruption
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Blazing Scales
features.description: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.description: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

adversaries.name: Young Ice Dragon
adversaries.description: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.description: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: No Hope
features.description: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.description: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
